active_continuity: Taekyung believes Ares Guild used mental magic to manipulate witnesses' memories and knows Ares personnel searched his phone and cloud storage.
Im Kkeokjeong regained consciousness after three days, had both arms reattached, and must avoid strenuous activity for at least two weeks; his return as a Hunter remains uncertain.
Butler Kim and Team Leader Choi funded and arranged Im Kkeokjeong's treatment, and Choi accepts responsibility for the Guild's failure to prevent the attack.
Taekyung defeated the immediate attackers and forced Lee Jungryong to withdraw with Park Jihoon, while sustaining a slight Internal Injury.
Taekyung secured revenge and tacit promises of apology and compensation for Im Kkeokjeong, creating an opportunity for the Peace Guild to grow.
Team Leader Choi intends to make the Peace Guild the world's greatest Guild and accepts responsibility for its actions.
Lee Jungryong is calculating, ruthless, and willing to erase witnesses; his apparent concern for Park Jihoon was an act.
Go Jun, also known as Team Leader Seok, is Lee Jungryong's prized Disciple and right-hand man, personally selected and trained by Lee.
Lee Jungryong ordered Go Jun to monitor Taekyung and intervene if Taekyung became a problem; Go Jun has now attacked Taekyung and been defeated.
Park Jihoon's eventual survival and recovery after Lee ordered him treated only minimally remain unknown.
Team Leader Choi has known Lee Jungryong since childhood, worked for Ares Guild for roughly three or four years, was transferred overseas by Lee, and later resigned.
Kim Hwajong saved Lee Jungryong's life during the collapse of Mapo Bridge eighteen years earlier and now deeply regrets doing so.
Soyeong, Team Leader Choi's deceased mother, was Cheon Taemin's daughter; Choi is Cheon Taemin's maternal grandson.
Cheon Taemin is the Ares Guild Master, humanity's great hero, the world's greatest Hunter, and the Slayer who killed the Demon King.
Lee Jungryong visited the hospital to assert his power rather than apologize, brought lilies and compensation money, and demanded the captives after negotiations.
Lee Jungryong recognizes that Taekyung learned martial arts from an unidentified older brother or teacher, but the person's identity and connection to Lee remain unresolved.
